legend: The gross appearance of juvenile papillomatosis comprises a discrete mass with cysts and intervening fibrous areas with interspersed yellowish and whitish appearances.
A low-power scanning view of juvenile papillomatosis shows cysts, intraductal papillomas, and apocrine metaplasia within dense stroma.
Papillary apocrine hyperplasia in a cyst of juvenile papillomatosis.
A distended duct shows florid usual-type ductal hyperplasia.

Juvenile papillomatosis of the breast shows multiple cystically dilated ducts lined by variably attenuated epithelium. Several dilated ducts contain luminal pink proteinaceous material and foamy histiocytes. Papillary apocrine metaplasia, moderate usual ductal hyperplasia, papillary fronds, patchy mild chronic inflammation, and fibrosis with entrapped epithelial nests are present.
